recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13530; future definition wording changes should be handled through the later terminology issue family or THO/UTG if a new final decision is made.
issue_request: FHIR-13530 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested adding unconfirmed to the Condition.verificationStatus value set as a parent of provisional and differential, with the definition "There is not sufficient diagnostic and/or clinical evidence to treat this as a confirmed condition."
initial_application: Git commit 1afa3503ac4fcef5a2d591f73dc5a1a143a1da25 applied #13530 by adding unconfirmed to the Condition spreadsheet, setting provisional and differential as children, and updating the Condition.verificationStatus short display. Later terminology refactoring moved the authoritative CodeSystem content to THO and left the active core ValueSet as an include of the THO condition-ver-status CodeSystem.
additional_context: Condition remains active in source/fhir.ini. source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml binds Condition.verificationStatus to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-ver-status and lists unconfirmed, provisional, and differential in the element short. source/condition/valueset-condition-ver-status.xml includes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status, and THO version 2.0.1 contains unconfirmed with provisional and differential nested below it. Later Applied issues FHIR-32479 and FHIR-32480 intentionally changed unconfirmed/confirmed definition wording, so the current definition need not match the original FHIR-13530 sentence exactly.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the requested code and hierarchy are present in the authoritative terminology dependency used by the current build, and duplicating CodeSystem content in core would be incorrect after the THO migration.
